facts.claim: Sky News and The Times reported on November 25 that the RAF is moving aircraft under cover at night to protect them against possible drone threats.
The Ministry of Defence told ADS Advance it was strengthening security at military sites but did not confirm the reported aircraft movements.
Anti-drone netting was under consideration for aircraft that remain outside.

A hardened aircraft shelter is a heavily reinforced hangar of thick reinforced concrete with heavy blast doors, sometimes covered with plants or soil for camouflage, usually housing one or two fighter jets.
The shelter is designed to reduce blast damage, stop flying fragments, conceal the aircraft from overhead observers, and separate aircraft so one blast damages fewer jets.
At former RAF Upper Heyford, Cold War shelters were built with reinforced concrete and heavy sliding doors, and some now form part of a scheduled monument.
The A400M Atlas maintenance hangar opened in 2018 covers 24,000 square metres and is intended to house three Atlas aircraft at a time.

The MOD said it is investing an additional £470 million in military site security, including physical protection, surveillance and counter-drone capabilities, and has introduced restricted airspace over 44 critical defence sites.

The reports appeared a day after the MOD and the National Protective Security Authority warned UK companies supplying Ukraine's armed forces of a growing Russian sabotage threat, and officials have drawn no public link between the alert and the reported aircraft movements.

zh.title: 英國皇家空軍夜間把戰機移入強化機堡 防範無人機威脅
zh.summary: 英國媒體報導，皇家空軍正於夜間把飛機移入機庫與強化機堡，以防範可能的無人機威脅；國防部表示正在加強軍事基地安全，但未證實相關調動。本文介紹強化機堡的構造與功用。
body: 根據《天空新聞》與《泰晤士報》11月25日的報導，英國皇家空軍正於夜間把飛機移入掩體，以防範可能的無人機威脅。英國國防部向《ADS Advance》表示，正在加強軍事基地的安全，但未證實報導中的飛機調動。報導亦指出，當局正在考慮為仍停放在戶外的飛機加裝反無人機防護網。
強化機堡（HAS）與一般機庫不同：它是以厚重鋼筋混凝土建造、配備重型防爆門的重型加固機庫，通常可容納一至兩架戰機，頂部有時會覆土植草作為偽裝。它的功用有四：減輕爆炸衝擊波的破壞、攔截可能刺穿機身、座艙罩或油箱的破片、關上大門後讓空中觀測者無法得知機堡內是否有飛機，以及把戰機分開存放、降低一次爆炸波及多架飛機的風險。

英國空軍使用強化機堡的歷史可追溯至冷戰時期：牛津郡前皇家空軍上黑福德基地的機堡以鋼筋混凝土與重型滑門建造，部分如今已列為法定古蹟；冷戰期間這類機堡在英國與其他北約國家大量興建，雖有部分已退役，國防部仍維持了一批強化設施。平時皇家空軍多半把飛機停在戶外，因為加油、輕度維護與戰備都更方便；大型機庫則優先供維修使用，例如2018年啟用的A400M維修機庫面積達2.4萬平方公尺、僅能同時容納3架飛機。國防部表示，正額外投資4.7億英鎊強化軍事基地安全，包括實體防護、監控與反無人機能力，並已在44處關鍵國防設施上空劃設限制空域。報導出現的前一天，國防部與隸屬軍情五處的國家保護安全局才警告向烏克蘭武裝部隊供貨的英國企業，俄羅斯破壞威脅正在升高；官員並未公開把這項警告與夜間移機的報導連結起來。

en.title: What a hardened aircraft shelter is, and why the RAF is using them at night
en.summary: British media report the Royal Air Force is moving aircraft under cover at night to protect them against possible drone threats; the Ministry of Defence says it is strengthening security at military sites but has not confirmed the reported movements. This explainer describes what a hardened aircraft shelter is and how it protects jets on the ground.
body: The UK's Royal Air Force is moving aircraft under cover at night to protect them against possible drone threats, according to reports published by Sky News and The Times on November 25. The Ministry of Defence told ADS Advance it was strengthening security at military sites but did not confirm the reported aircraft movements. Sky also reported that anti-drone netting was under consideration for aircraft that remain outside.

A hardened aircraft shelter (HAS), or protective aircraft shelter, is a heavily reinforced hangar built to protect aircraft on the ground from attacks. They are typically constructed from thick, reinforced concrete with heavy blast doors, and may be covered with plants or soil for camouflage. Each shelter will usually house either one or two fighter jets. The shelter is designed to reduce blast damage from a nearby explosion, stop flying fragments that could puncture the aircraft's skin, canopy or fuel tanks, conceal the aircraft from overhead observers once the doors are closed, and separate aircraft from one another so that one blast is less likely to damage several jets.

The UK's air force has a long history with hardened shelters. At the former RAF Upper Heyford in Oxfordshire, Cold War aircraft shelters were built with reinforced concrete and heavy sliding doors, and some now form part of a scheduled monument. During the Cold War, hardened shelters proliferated in the UK and in other NATO nations; although some are now decommissioned, the MOD has maintained a range of hardened facilities. Normally most of the RAF fleet is parked outside, because refuelling, light maintenance and readiness are all easier with aircraft accessible, and large hangars are prioritised for maintenance: the A400M Atlas maintenance hangar, opened in 2018, covers 24,000 square metres yet is intended to house only three Atlas aircraft at a time. The ministry said it was investing an additional £470 million in military site security, including physical protection, surveillance and counter-drone capabilities, and has introduced restricted airspace over 44 critical defence sites. The reports appeared a day after the ministry and the National Protective Security Authority, part of MI5, warned UK companies supplying Ukraine's armed forces of a growing Russian sabotage threat; officials have drawn no public link between that alert and the reported decision about where RAF aircraft spend the night.
